title: Fig. 20: Gemini Launch Sequence trajectory chart (altitude vs. range)
description: Chart titled "GEMINI LAUNCH SEQUENCE" plotting altitude against "RANGE-NAUTICAL MILES" for the Gemini launch, with timed events from "0:00 LIFT OFF" through roll, pitch, "1:03 MACH ONE," "1:19 MAX Q," "2:34 BECO," "5:36 SECO" and "5:58 S/C SEP." Abort modes I, II and III are annotated with their procedures (eject, salvo retros, landing sequence). Accompanying text notes the GT-4 insertion altitude of 87 miles and a first apogee of 161 miles.
